source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. The main theme of the storyteller hero: nostalgic, hopeful and gently heroic, like opening an old illuminated book at dawn. A soft harp prelude, then a noble, singable flute melody in waltz time; the strings swell in the second half and the theme is restated with fuller orchestra and soft timpani before settling back. Tempo 92 BPM, 3/4 time, key of G major. Instrumentation: concert harp, solo wooden flute, violins and cellos, french horn, soft timpani, glockenspiel sparkle. Form: 4-bar harp intro, theme A (flute), theme B (strings and horn), theme A reprise with full orchestra. Duration: 95 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
